hooks.name: Credit new assets
hooks.description: Keeps README asset credits complete: whenever an image, sound or font is added to public/, the agent must add its source and licence before moving on.

action.prompt: A new file was created under public/. Before continuing, add a row for it to the "Asset credits" table in README.md: file path, source with a link, author if known, licence, and any edit made (trimmed, recoloured, figure painted out). Follow .kiro/steering/assets-and-licensing.md. If the source or licence is unknown, stop and ask the user instead of guessing.
